dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a broad pixel radius at the highest point of the dorsal fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree concave slope relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Visible vertical height to visible base width ratio is approximately 1:1.2.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, shallow convex arc across the visible dorsal-cranial boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distribution of small, circular white punctate lesions across the dorsal and lateral surfaces; a larger, irregular white depigmented patch is present on the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense 'salt-and-pepper' patterning consisting of numerous small depigmented spots across the dorsal surface.
